name: Tushen Cloud Computing (Kwamfutar Gajimare)
objectives: Idan aka ba ku jerin manhajojin yau da kullum da misalin ƙaramin kasuwanci, bayanin mene ne cloud computing da ambaton manyan amfaninsa da haɗarinsa, da kalmominku, tare da aƙalla amfani biyu da haɗari ɗaya
Idan aka ba ku hidimomin cloud guda shida, rarraba kowanne zuwa SaaS, PaaS ko IaaS da faɗin abin da ke hannunku a kowanne, kuna samun aƙalla 5 cikin 6 daidai
Ta amfani da Google Drive ko OneDrive, ƙirƙirar folda, ƙara fayiloli biyu da ba su sunaye masu sarari, ba tare da taimako ba, ta yadda wani zai iya samun kowane fayil ta sunansa

Idan aka ba ku fayil da mutumin da za ku raba shi da shi, raba fayil ɗin da mafi ƙarancin damar da ake buƙata, duba wa ke da damar shiga da cire damar, ba tare da barin wani fayil a buɗe ga mutanen da ba sa buƙatarsa ba
A asusunku na Google ko Microsoft, kunna tabbatarwa mataki biyu, duba na'urorin da suka shiga asusun da gane saƙon zamba (phishing), kafin a gama aikin ƙarshe

lessons.title: Darasi 1: Cloud da kalmomi masu sauƙi
lessons.text:
Darasi 1 cikin 6 · kusan minti 4
Manufa: Bayyana da kalmominku mene ne cloud computing.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Idan aka ba ku jerin manhajojin yau da kullum da misalin ƙaramin kasuwanci, za ku iya bayanin mene ne cloud computing da ambaton manyan amfaninsa da haɗarinsa, da kalmominku, tare da aƙalla amfani biyu da haɗari ɗaya.
"Cloud" (gajimare) yana nufin kwamfutoci a manyan gine-gine da ake kira cibiyoyin bayanai (data centers) waɗanda kuke amfani da su ta intanet. Maimakon ku ajiye komai a wayarku ko kwamfutarku, fayilolinku, manhajojinku da ƙarfin kwamfuta suna kan waɗannan kwamfutoci, kuma kuna kai musu daga kowace na'ura.
Ku yi tunanin wutar lantarki. Ba ku gina tashar wuta a gida; kuna haɗawa kawai kuna biyan abin da kuka yi amfani da shi. Cloud computing yana aiki haka: kamfani ne ke mallakar kwamfutocin, kuma mutane da kasuwanci suna amfani da abin da suke buƙata, a lokacin da suke buƙata.
Misalan yau da kullum: imel na Gmail da Outlook, Google Drive, OneDrive, iCloud da Dropbox don fayiloli, Netflix da Spotify don kallo da sauraro ta intanet, da mataimakan AI kamar ChatGPT ko Copilot, waɗanda ke aiki a kan kwamfutocin cloud.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Cloud computing: amfani da kwamfutoci, ajiya da shirye-shirye ta intanet maimakon a na'urarku.
- Cibiyar bayanai (data center): babban gini cike da kwamfutoci masu gudanar da hidimomin cloud.
- Server: kwamfuta mai ƙarfi da ke bayar da hidima ga sauran kwamfutoci ta hanyar sadarwa.
Gwada yanzu: Ku rubuta manhajoji ko shafukan intanet guda biyar da kuka yi amfani da su a wannan makon. Kusa da kowanne, ku rubuta "cloud" idan kayanku suna ajiye ko suna aiki a kwamfutocin kamfanin, ba a na'urarku kaɗai ba.
Yanzu za ku iya bayanin cloud computing da kalmominku da nuna hidimomin cloud da kuke riga kuna amfani da su.

check.q: Ina fayilolinku suke idan kun ajiye su a cloud?
options: A kwamfutoci a cibiyar bayanai da kuke kai musu ta intanet
A katin ajiya na wayarku kaɗai
A faifan da kuke aika wa kamfanin ta gidan waya
A cikin saƙonnin tes na wayarku
check.why: Cloud kwamfutoci ne a cibiyoyin bayanai da kuke amfani da su ta intanet daga kowace na'ura.

check.q: Aboki ya tambaye ku me yasa cloud yake kamar wutar lantarki. Me za ku ce?
options: Duka biyun suna daina aiki da dare
Duka biyun suna buƙatar waya zuwa gidanku
Kuna amfani da abin da kuke buƙata ba tare da mallakar kwamfutocin ba, kamar wuta ba tare da tashar wuta ba
Duka biyun kyauta ne ga kowa
check.why: Darasin ya kwatanta cloud da haɗawa da biyan wuta ba tare da gina tashar wuta ba.

lessons.title: Darasi 2: Me yasa mutane da kasuwanci suke amfani da cloud
lessons.text:
Darasi 2 cikin 6 · kusan minti 5
Manufa: Ambaci manyan amfani da haɗarin cloud.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Idan aka ba ku jerin manhajojin yau da kullum da misalin ƙaramin kasuwanci, za ku iya bayanin mene ne cloud computing da ambaton manyan amfaninsa da haɗarinsa, da kalmominku, tare da aƙalla amfani biyu da haɗari ɗaya.
Amfani: kuna iya kai wa fayilolinku daga kowace na'ura; ɓacewar waya ba ta nufin ɓacewar hotuna; ƙungiya za ta iya aiki a takarda ɗaya a lokaci ɗaya; kuma kasuwanci zai iya farawa ƙarami ya girma, yana biyan ƙarin ƙarfin kwamfuta kawai idan yana buƙata, maimakon sayen servers masu tsada.
Haɗari: kuna buƙatar intanet; idan wani ya saci kalmar sirrinku, zai iya kai wa fayilolinku daga ko'ina; shirye-shiryen kyauta suna da iyakar ajiya; kuma kamfani ne ke riƙe da bayananku, don haka ya kamata ku san saitunan sirrinsa.
Manyan kamfanonin cloud na kasuwanci sun haɗa da Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure da Google Cloud. Ga mutane na yau da kullum, Google, Microsoft, Apple da Dropbox suna bayar da ajiyar cloud kyauta tare da ƙari na kuɗi. Ku duba shafin kowane kamfani don ganin yawan ajiyar kyauta na yanzu.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Scalability (sassaucin girma): ikon ƙara ko rage ƙarfin kwamfuta yadda ake buƙata.
- Mai bayar da hidima (provider): kamfanin da ke gudanar da hidimar cloud.
- Iyakar ajiya: mafi yawan bayanan da shirinku ya bar ku ajiye.
Gwada yanzu: Ku yi tunanin ƙaramin kasuwanci da kuka sani, kamar shagon aski, motar sayar da abinci ko ofishin coci. Ku rubuta hanyoyi biyu da cloud zai iya taimaka masa da haɗari ɗaya da ya kamata ya shirya masa.
Yanzu za ku iya ambaton manyan amfani da haɗarin cloud da manyan kamfanonin cloud.

check.q: Wanne ne amfanin ajiye hotunanku a cloud?
options: Ba za ku taɓa buƙatar intanet ba
Ɓacewar waya ba ta nufin ɓacewar hotuna
Shirye-shiryen kyauta ba su da iyakar ajiya
Babu kamfanin da ke riƙe da bayananku
check.why: Kwafin cloud yana nan lafiya a kwamfutocin kamfanin ko da waya ta ɓace.

check.q: Mai motar sayar da abinci yana son mayar da bayanansa zuwa cloud. Wane haɗari ya kamata ya fara shiryawa?
options: Cloud yana ƙara girman fayiloli
Cloud yana aiki a na'ura ɗaya kawai
Ba za a iya raba fayilolin cloud da ma'aikata ba
Wanda ke da kalmar sirri da aka sata zai iya kai wa fayilolin daga ko'ina
check.why: Kalmar sirri da aka sata tana buɗe fayilolin cloud daga ko'ina, don haka kiyaye asusu yana da muhimmanci.

lessons.title: Darasi 3: SaaS, PaaS da IaaS: nau'o'in hidima guda uku
lessons.text:
Darasi 3 cikin 6 · kusan minti 5
Manufa: Rarraba hidimomin cloud zuwa SaaS, PaaS da IaaS.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Idan aka ba ku hidimomin cloud guda shida, za ku iya rarraba kowanne zuwa SaaS, PaaS ko IaaS da faɗin abin da ke hannunku a kowanne, kuna samun aƙalla 5 cikin 6 daidai.
Hidimomin cloud suna da manyan nau'o'i uku, gwargwadon yawan abin da kamfanin yake yi muku. Ku yi amfani da misalin pizza: kuna iya sayen pizza da aka gama, ku yi hayar kicin tare da kayan haɗi, ko ku yi hayar murhu (oven) kawai.
SaaS (Software as a Service, shiri a matsayin hidima): shirin da aka gama da kuke amfani da shi a burauza ko manhaja, kamar Gmail, Google Docs, Microsoft 365 ko Zoom. Kamfanin ne ke gudanar da komai. PaaS (Platform as a Service, dandali a matsayin hidima): dandali da aka shirya inda masu haɓaka shirye-shirye (developers) suke ginawa da gudanar da manhajojinsu ba tare da kula da servers ba, kamar Google App Engine ko Azure App Service. IaaS (Infrastructure as a Service, ababen more rayuwa a matsayin hidima): kwamfutoci na kama-da-wane (virtual), ajiya da hanyoyin sadarwa da kuke saitawa da kanku, kamar Amazon EC2 ko Azure Virtual Machines.
A kowane nau'i, tsaro abin rabawa ne. Kamfanin yana kare cibiyoyin bayanansa; ku kuma koyaushe kuna da alhakin kalmar sirrinku, wanda kuke raba wa abubuwa, da abin da kuke ɗorawa.
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku tambaya: shin ina amfani da shirin da aka gama kawai? Wannan SaaS ne.
- Shin ina gina manhajata a kan dandali da aka shirya? Wannan PaaS ne.
- Shin ina saita kwamfutocina na kama-da-wane? Wannan IaaS ne.
- A dukkan ukun, ku kiyaye asusunku da bayananku.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- SaaS: Software as a Service: shirin da aka gama da kuke amfani da shi ta intanet.
- PaaS: Platform as a Service: dandali da aka shirya don ginawa da gudanar da manhajojinku.
- IaaS: Infrastructure as a Service: kwamfutoci na kama-da-wane, ajiya da hanyoyin sadarwa da kuke haya kuke kula da su.
- Rabon alhaki (shared responsibility): kamfanin yana kare cloud; ku kuma kuna kare asusunku da bayananku da ke cikinsa.
Gwada yanzu: Ku rarraba waɗannan zuwa SaaS, PaaS ko IaaS: Gmail, Azure Virtual Machines, Google App Engine, Zoom, Amazon EC2, Microsoft 365. Ku duba amsoshinku da misalan da ke wannan darasi.
Yanzu za ku iya rarraba hidimomin cloud zuwa SaaS, PaaS da IaaS da bayanin rabon alhaki.

check.q: Google App Engine yana bar masu haɓaka shirye-shirye su gudanar da manhajojinsu ba tare da kula da servers ba. Wane nau'i ne?
options: SaaS
IaaS
PaaS
Ba ɗaya daga cikin nau'o'in uku ba
check.why: Dandali da aka shirya inda masu haɓaka shirye-shirye suke ginawa da gudanar da manhajoji shi ne Platform as a Service.

check.q: Makarantarku tana amfani da Microsoft 365, wanda SaaS ne. Me ya rage a hannunku?
options: Kare kalmar sirrinku da zaɓar wanda kuke raba wa abubuwa
Gadin ginin cibiyar bayanai
Gyara servers na kamfanin
Babu komai; SaaS yana nufin kamfanin yana yin komai
check.why: Tsaro abin rabawa ne: kamfanin yana gudanar da hidimar, amma kalmar sirrinku da rabawa koyaushe naku ne.

chapters.name: Babi na 2: Amfani da cloud da kanku

lessons.title: Darasi 4: Ajiye da tsara fayiloli a ajiyar cloud
lessons.text:
Darasi 4 cikin 6 · kusan minti 5
Manufa: Ɗora, ƙirƙira da tsara fayiloli a Google Drive ko OneDrive.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Ta amfani da Google Drive ko OneDrive, za ku iya ƙirƙirar folda, ƙara fayiloli biyu da ba su sunaye masu sarari, ba tare da taimako ba, ta yadda wani zai iya samun kowane fayil ta sunansa.
Google Drive yana zuwa tare da asusun Google kyauta, OneDrive kuma yana zuwa tare da asusun Microsoft kyauta. Duka biyun suna aiki a burauzar intanet (drive.google.com ko onedrive.com) da kuma a matsayin manhajojin waya daga shagon manhajoji na hukuma.
Ku yi amfani da maɓallin New don ƙirƙirar folda ko takarda, ko Upload don ƙara fayil daga na'urarku. Ku ba fayiloli sunaye masu sarari, kamar "Resume - Jordan Lee - 2026", don ku same su daga baya. Ku sa fayilolin da suke da alaƙa a cikin folda ɗaya.
Daidaitawa (sync) tana sa fayil ya kasance iri ɗaya a kowace na'ura: idan kun canja shi a kwamfutarku, sabon sigar zai bayyana a wayarku. Hidimomin cloud da yawa kuma suna ajiye tsofaffin sigogi, don ku iya komawa idan kun yi kuskure.
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku shiga a drive.google.com ko onedrive.com (ko ku buɗe manhajar).
- Ku danna New ku zaɓi Folder; ku ba ta suna mai sarari.
- Ku buɗe foldar; ku danna New don ƙirƙirar takarda, ko Upload don ƙara fayil.
- Ku canja sunayen fayiloli zuwa sunaye masu sarari.
- Ku buɗe fayil ɗin a wata na'ura don ganin yana daidaita.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Upload (ɗorawa): kwafa fayil daga na'urarku zuwa cloud.
- Sync (daidaitawa): sa fayiloli su kasance iri ɗaya a dukkan na'urorinku kai tsaye.
- Tarihin sigogi (version history): tsofaffin kwafin fayil da aka ajiye da za ku iya komawa gare su.
Gwada yanzu: A Google Drive ko OneDrive, ku ƙirƙiri folda mai suna "Career Documents". Ku ƙirƙiri ko ku ɗora fayiloli biyu a cikinta ku ba su sunaye masu sarari. Sannan ku buɗe foldar a na'ura ta biyu idan kuna da ita.
Yanzu za ku iya ɗorawa, ƙirƙira, ba da suna da tsara fayiloli a ajiyar cloud, da sanin cewa suna daidaita a dukkan na'urori.

check.q: Me "sync" (daidaitawa) yake yi wa fayil a OneDrive?
options: Yana goge tsohon kwafi kowane dare
Yana sa sigar fayil ɗin ta kasance iri ɗaya a dukkan na'urorinku
Yana aika fayil ɗin ga kowa a cikin lambobinku
Yana mayar da fayil ɗin PDF
check.why: Daidaitawa tana sa fayil ya kasance iri ɗaya a kowace na'ura da kuke amfani da ita.

check.q: Kun ajiye wasiƙar neman aiki da suna "doc1". Me za ku yi don ku same ta daga baya?
options: Ku bar ta; bincike zai yi tsammani
Ku yi sabuwar folda ga kowane fayil
Ku sake ɗora ta da suna ɗaya
Ku canja sunanta zuwa mai sarari, kamar "Cover Letter - Jordan Lee - 2026"
check.why: Sunaye masu sarari suna sa a sami fayiloli cikin sauƙi daga baya.

lessons.title: Darasi 5: Raba fayiloli lafiya
lessons.text:
Darasi 5 cikin 6 · kusan minti 5
Manufa: Raba fayil da mutumin da ya dace da matakin damar da ya dace, da cire damar.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Idan aka ba ku fayil da mutumin da za ku raba shi da shi, za ku iya raba fayil ɗin da mafi ƙarancin damar da ake buƙata, duba wa ke da damar shiga da cire damar, ba tare da barin wani fayil a buɗe ga mutanen da ba sa buƙatarsa ba.
Fayilolin cloud suna da sauƙin rabawa, wanda yake da amfani kuma yake da haɗari. Ku danna Share a kan fayil ku ƙara adireshin imel na mutum, ko ku kwafi hanyar haɗi (link). Ku zaɓi abin da za su iya yi: kallo (view), sharhi (comment) ko gyara (edit).
Ku ba da mafi ƙarancin damar da ake buƙata. Takardar bayanin aiki ga mai ɗaukar aiki: kallo kawai. Aikin ƙungiya: gyara ga 'yan ƙungiyarku. Ku yi hankali da hanyar haɗi da aka saita ta yadda "anyone with the link" (kowa mai hanyar haɗin) zai iya buɗe fayil ɗin; duk wanda ya sami hanyar haɗin zai iya ganinsa, ko da an tura shi gaba.
Ku duba wa ke da damar shiga daga allon Share ko Manage access, ku cire mutane idan aiki ya ƙare. Kada ku taɓa sa fayiloli masu lambobin Social Security, bayanan banki ko kalmomin sirri a foldar da ake rabawa.
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku zaɓi fayil ɗin ku danna Share.
- Ku ƙara imel na mutumin, ko ku kwafi hanyar haɗi.
- Ku zaɓi View, Comment ko Edit; ku zaɓi mafi ƙanƙanta da yake buƙata.
- Ku guji "anyone with the link" don fayilolin sirri.
- Daga baya, ku buɗe Share ko Manage access ku cire mutanen da ba sa buƙata kuma.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Matakin izini: abin da wani zai iya yi da fayil ɗinku: kallo, sharhi ko gyara.
- Mafi ƙarancin dama (least access): ba mutane damar da suke buƙata da gaske kawai.
Gwada yanzu: Ku raba fayil ɗaya daga foldar "Career Documents" da aboki ko wani a iyali don kallo kawai. Ku ce su buɗe shi. Sannan ku buɗe Manage access ku cire su.
Yanzu za ku iya raba fayil na cloud da matakin izinin da ya dace da cire damar idan ba a buƙata kuma.

check.q: Wane saitin rabawa ne yake ba da mafi ƙarancin dama?
options: Edit
Comment
View
Owner
check.why: View yana bar mutane su buɗe fayil ɗin amma ba su canja shi ba, wannan shi ne mafi ƙarancin dama.

check.q: Aikin ƙungiyarku ya ƙare kuma abokan aji huɗu har yanzu suna da damar gyara. Me za ku yi?
options: Ku buɗe Manage access ku cire mutanen da ba sa buƙata kuma
Ku canja hanyar haɗin zuwa "anyone with the link"
Ku goge asusunku gaba ɗaya
Ku bar shi idan wata rana za su buƙata
check.why: Ku cire dama idan aiki ya ƙare don waɗanda ke buƙatar fayil ɗin kawai su iya kai masa.

lessons.title: Darasi 6: Kiyaye asusunku na cloud
lessons.text:
Darasi 6 cikin 6 · kusan minti 5
Manufa: Kunna tabbatarwa mataki biyu da duba tsaron asusunku.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: A asusunku na Google ko Microsoft, za ku iya kunna tabbatarwa mataki biyu, duba na'urorin da suka shiga asusun da gane saƙon zamba (phishing), kafin a gama aikin ƙarshe.
Asusunku na cloud yana riƙe da fayilolinku, imel da hotunanku, don haka ana kai masa hari. Mataki mafi muhimmanci shi ne tabbatarwa mataki biyu (two-step verification, ana kuma kiransa two-factor ko multi-factor authentication): bayan kalmar sirrinku, kuna kuma tabbatarwa da wayarku. Ɓarawon da ke da kalmar sirrinku kawai ba zai iya shiga ba.
Ku yi amfani da kalmar sirri mai tsawo wadda ba ku amfani da ita a wani wuri, zai fi kyau a ajiye ta a manajan kalmomin sirri (password manager). Google da Microsoft duka suna da shafin binciken tsaro (security check-up) a saitunan asusunku da ke nuna na'urorin da suka shiga, ayyukan kwanan nan da hanyoyin dawo da asusu.
Ku yi hankali da phishing (zamba ta saƙo): imel na bogi da ke cewa "your storage is full" (ajiyarku ta cika) ko "someone shared a file with you" (wani ya raba muku fayil) da ke kai ku shafin shiga na bogi. Ku je drive.google.com ko onedrive.com da kanku maimakon danna hanyar haɗi. Ku tuna rabon alhaki: kamfanin yana kare cibiyoyin bayanansa; ku kuma kuna kare asusunku.
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku buɗe saitunan tsaro na asusunku na Google ko Microsoft.
- Ku kunna tabbatarwa mataki biyu.
- Ku duba cewa lambar waya da imel na dawo da asusu daidai ne.
- Ku duba na'urorin da suka shiga ku cire duk wadda ba ku sani ba.
- Ku je shafukan cloud da kanku maimakon danna hanyoyin haɗi a imel.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Tabbatarwa mataki biyu: dubawa ta biyu, kamar code ko taɓawa a wayarku, bayan kalmar sirrinku.
- Manajan kalmomin sirri (password manager): manhajar da ke ƙirƙira da ajiye kalmomin sirri masu ƙarfi a madadinku.
- Phishing (zamba ta saƙo): saƙon bogi da ke ƙoƙarin yaudarar ku ku bayar da kalmar sirrinku.
Gwada yanzu: Atisayen aikin ƙarshe: ku buɗe saitunan tsaro na asusunku na Google ko Microsoft, ku kunna tabbatarwa mataki biyu, ku duba na'urorin da suka shiga. Sannan ku gama aikin ƙarshe da foldar "Career Documents".
Yanzu za ku iya kare asusunku na cloud da tabbatarwa mataki biyu, binciken tsaro da sanin alamun phishing.
Yadda ake duba aikinku na ƙarshe:
Abin da muke dubawa Har yanzu bai kai ba Ya cika Ya wuce Folda da fayiloli Babu foldar "Career Documents", ko fayilolin suna da sunaye marasa sarari kamar "doc1". Foldar tana da fayiloli biyu masu sunaye masu sarari. An kuma buɗe fayilolin a na'ura ta biyu don nuna suna daidaita. Rabawa lafiya An raba fayil ɗin da damar gyara ko a matsayin "anyone with the link", ko ba a taɓa cire damar ba. An raba fayil ɗaya don kallo kawai, an duba wa ke da dama, sannan aka cire ta. Zai iya bayyana dalilin da yasa kallo kawai shi ne mafi ƙarancin damar da ake buƙata. An kare asusu Tabbatarwa mataki biyu a kashe take. Tabbatarwa mataki biyu a kunne take kuma an duba na'urorin da suka shiga. An kuma duba lambar waya da imel na dawo da asusu, kuma mai koyo zai iya ambaci alamar gargaɗin phishing ɗaya. An bayyana cloud Jimloli ukun ba su nan ko ba su faɗi mene ne cloud ba. Jimloli uku masu sarari sun faɗi mene ne cloud kuma sun ba da amfani ɗaya da haɗari ɗaya. Jimlolin sun kuma yi amfani da kwatanci na yau da kullum, kamar wutar lantarki. Nau'o'in hidima Ɗaya ko fiye daga cikin misalan SaaS, PaaS da IaaS ba daidai ba ne ko ba su nan. Misali ɗaya daidai na kowanne: SaaS, PaaS da IaaS. Ya kuma faɗi abin da ya rage a hannun mai amfani a rabon alhaki. Don cin nasara: "Ya cika" ko "Ya wuce" a kowane layi. Idan wani layi "Bai kai ba tukuna", ku gyara wannan sashe ku sake gwadawa.

options: Rubuta kalmar sirrinku sau biyu
Samun asusun imel biyu daban-daban
Ajiye kalmar sirrinku a wurare biyu
Dubawa ta biyu, sau da yawa a wayarku, bayan kalmar sirrinku
check.why: Bayan kalmar sirri, kuna kuma tabbatarwa da wayarku, don haka ɓarawon da ke da kalmar sirri kawai ba zai iya shiga ba.

check.q: Kun ga wayar da ba ku sani ba a cikin na'urorin da suka shiga asusunku. Me za ku yi?
options: Ku yi watsi da ita; wataƙila ba komai
Ku cire ta ku canja kalmar sirrinku
Ku raba kalmar sirrinku da ita
Ku kashe tabbatarwa mataki biyu
check.why: Cire na'urorin da ba a sani ba a binciken tsaro yana hana baƙi shiga asusunku.
